## What changed

Housekeeping on this project's own documentation. Nothing changes for you.

- **This project now declares a Diátaxis mode on the documents it owns.** It
  does not switch on `require-mode`, which would demand a mode from every
  document in the tree, including the ones it inherits from upstream. Worth
  knowing if you were wondering whether to set that flag: `lat check mode`
  already checks any document that declares a mode, with or without the flag.
  The flag only adds the rule that a document must declare one.

## Upgrading

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
